overview: AI Assist Modem Protocol Script Development workspace where users enter TP test IDs, fetch test data, and run a backend-driven pipeline with live status indicators.
features: Enter TP test IDs and auto-fetch Request Type and Request Details from the TP API
Start button triggers backend-driven pipeline orchestration across three stages
Three pipeline indicators (NLP Parser, Encoder, Script Generator) update live from backend state
Results button enabled when the Encoder stage completes
Test rows persist locally across sessions
